terms.title: Referral programme terms
items: Who can refer. Any business subscribed to a paid FOVE plan. Credit is only earned if your business is on a paid plan on the date it is earned.
How to refer. Share your referral link. The business you recommend (the "referral") must create its FOVE account within 30 days of clicking your link.
What the referral gets. A discount on its first annual subscription to a paid plan, in the currency of its invoice: €20, $20, MAD 200, DZD 4,000 or CDF 65,000. Once per business.

What you get. A credit per referral, in the currency of your subscription (€20, $20, MAD 200, DZD 4,000 or CDF 65,000), earned 14 days after its first annual payment, provided it has not been refunded or cancelled during that period.

Cap. Per calendar year (1 January to 31 December), your earnings are capped at the lower of these two amounts: €200 ($200, MAD 2,000, DZD 40,000 or CDF 650,000 depending on the currency of your subscription), or the annual price of your plan when the credit is earned. Beyond that, your referrals keep their discount, but you earn no more credit until the following 1 January. The number of referrals is not limited.
Using credit. Your credit is automatically deducted from your next FOVE invoices, oldest first. It cannot be paid out in cash, transferred or exchanged.
Expiry. Each credit expires 3 years after it was earned if it has not been used.

Exclusions. No credit is granted when the referrer and the referral share an owner, use the same payment method, or when the same business is referred more than once. If the referral came through a FOVE sales partner's link before yours, the partner is rewarded.
Fraud. FOVE may cancel credit obtained abusively or fraudulently.
Partner programme. If you recommend FOVE regularly, you can join the partner programme and earn a commission instead of credit.
Changes. FOVE may change or end this programme; credit already earned remains usable until it expires.
